# SUGR Website Agent Instructions

Before making changes, read:

docs/REVIVAL-SPEC.md

Treat that document as the authoritative project specification.

This is a static website.

Prefer simple HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript.

Do not introduce frameworks, package managers, databases, server-side
components or external dependencies unless explicitly requested.

Do not invent project facts, historical claims, partnerships, statistics,
wallet addresses or endorsements.

Reuse existing project assets where appropriate.

Keep changes understandable to a non-professional developer.

When proposing substantial changes:

1. Explain what you intend to change.
2. Identify the files that will be affected.
3. Avoid unrelated modifications.
4. Preserve responsive/mobile behavior.
5. Keep the site compatible with Cloudflare Pages static hosting.

Do not modify the historical Git tag `legacy-v1.0.7`.

Never add secrets or credentials to this repository.
